'''Win Lewin''' is a young boy from the [[Two Rivers]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Win Lewin}}

== Appearance ==
He is lanky.{{ref/book|4|32}}

== Activities ==
Win is at [[Jac al'Seen]]'s farm when [[Perrin Aybara]] and his group visit. He tells everyone at the farm that Lord [[Luc]] has arrived.{{ref/book|4|32}}
